4-Day Short Luxury Safari Adventure

THE JOURNEY AT A GLANCE

Make every
day count.

This 4-day Tanzania safari begins with a relaxing night in Arusha before exploring Lake Manyara National park, Tarangire National park, and the Ngorongoro Crater. Enjoy game drives among elephants, lions, and flamingos while taking in the stunning scenery of northern Tanzania. A short yet unforgettable journey through some of Africa’s most iconic landscapes.

Duration4 days
Published styleLuxury
PlanningPersonalised
YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1Arrival in Arusha

On arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you’ll receive a warm welcome and be transferred to Arusha. After a short briefing, sharing fascinating stories and learn about the local people and their rich culture —offering a captivating introduction to Tanzanian life before your adventure into the wilderness unfolds.

Spend a relaxing night in Arusha, a lively city surrounded by beautiful landscapes and views of Mount Meru. It’s the perfect place to unwind, explore local cultures, and get ready for your safari adventure across Tanzania’s incredible national parks.

Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at your Arusha accommodation, where you can relax and recharge in comfort.

Stay Kahawa House

Meals & drinks Dinner (Breakfast & lunch not included) Non-alcoholic drinks

02DAY 2Lake Manyara National Park

Leaving Arusha, enjoy a beautiful drive through small villages and green highlands on your way to Lake Manyara National Park. The journey offers a glimpse of local life and stunning views before you arrive at the park, known for its elephants, hippos, and tree-climbing lions.

Stay Kitela Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

03DAY 3Tarangire National Park

Spend the day exploring Tarangire National Park, a peaceful haven known for its ancient baobab trees and large elephant herds. As you drive through the golden plains, you’ll spot giraffes, zebras, and maybe even a pride of lions making every moment feel like an unforgettable safari adventure.

Stay Kitela Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

04DAY 4Ngorongoro Crater

On your last day, explore the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater, teeming with wildlife from lions to flamingos. Take in the incredible scenery during your game drive, then relax as you’re driven back to Arusha, where your safari concludes with a drop-off at your hotel or the airport.

Stay No accommodation (End of tour)

Meals & drinks Breakfast & lunch (Dinner not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
